title: Design decisions
text: D-001 (2026-11-20) Package name trainingmodels. Checked pak::pkg_name_check: valid, free CRAN Bioconductor. D-002 (2026-11-18) First version scope: daily-series core, load descriptors, Banister impulse-response model. Later: Busso variable dose-response, fitness delay, Kalman filter, Bayesian version, DLNM via dlnm package (wrapped, reimplemented). D-003 (2026-11-18) Every formula verified source implementation; verification source recorded per method. D-004 (2026-11-18) Every method documented limitations (identifiability, wide intervals, assumptions), computation. D-005 (2026-11-18) Public repository day one; issues, pull requests releases; AI use disclosed (see AI_USAGE.md). D-006 (2026-11-18) pkgdown site start, one article per method. D-007 (2026-11-18) Numerical tests published examples independent reference implementation. D-008 (2026-11-18) Code, documentation commits English. D-009 (2026-11-19) package code written verified formulas; third-party code used external reference tests, never copied. D-010 (2026-11-20) bib/ folder (copyrighted papers) never committed.

title: Design decisions
text: -001 One daily-series class single entry point: validates input, sums -day sessions, marks day observed, rest missing. -002 Daily-calendar core adapted author’s ACWR 0.2.0 package (copied, imported). ACWR may later become wrapper. -003 Shiny app repository, shiny Suggests. -004 One exponential-filter engine impulse-response models (fitness-, Banister, fitness delay), computed recursive form. -005 Two-level fit: linear regression baseline gains, numerical search time constants (Busso & Chalencon 2023). -006 Model comparison AICc Akaike weights. -007 Reference values tests generated outside package R script Busso & Chalencon (2023, Supplemental Digital Content 2) dorem package; neither dependency. -008 dlnm REDI Suggests, version 0.3.

title: Design decisions
text: P-001 outcome students Banister (repeated performance tests ); whether Banister app simulation plus example data. P-002 students record per session rest days told apart missing days. P-003 students access app (local R hosted URL). P-004 Language theory documentation app interface. P-005 Planned research use next six months (JOSS vs JOSE). P-006 Accept Busso & Chalencon (2023) verification source Banister formula (sum n-1), Morton et al. (1990) citation check. P-007 Include fitness-model first version. P-008 Every fit reports trivial comparators (mean, straight line). P-009 Fit output foregrounds response single session (curve, t_n, t_g) individual parameters. P-010 Show half-life alongside time constants. P-011 User declares whether higher lower performance values better. P-012 App shows link EWMA Banister without gains. P-013 First version assumes zero initial fitness fatigue, documented limitation. P-014 Ask T. Busso swimmers’ dataset.
